{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the trial data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Identify the row with the highest sample_seq for each patient
trial_df_sorted = trial_df.sort_values('sample_seq', ascending=False)
trial_df_unique = trial_df_sorted.drop_duplicates(subset='patient_id', keep='first')

# Confirm the number of unique patients
assert len(trial_df_unique) == 800, "Expected 800 unique patients after deduplication"

# Check the distribution of severity
severity_counts = trial_df_unique['severity'].value_counts().sort_index()
print(severity_counts)"}
